notablePrerequisites: Aura of Dominion attached to Emmara.
description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's second ability by tapping Emmara.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Honor-Worn Shaku ability, untapping it.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping the Soldier, untapping Emmara.
Repeat.
